title: How To Build Your Team With Autonomous Humans, Not Just Autonomous Systems
snippet: As AI enables smaller, faster teams, companies should hire curious, adaptable people who challenge established practices and can be trusted to make independent decisions, according to guest author Eric Francia, who writes that giving employees real responsibility, encouraging questions and investing in continuous learning helps teams innovate, stay engaged and retain talent.

title: Cybersecurity Investors Put $6.8B To Work In The Third Quarter, Mostly In Larger Rounds
snippet: For the third quarter of 2026, global cybersecurity- and privacy-focused startups pulled in a total of $6.8 billion, per Crunchbase data. That’s up about 50% from the prior quarter and tied for the highest quarterly tally in years.

title: Exclusive: Chariot Raises $10M To Help Consumers Fight Back Against Hidden Fees And Hard-To-Cancel Subscriptions

snippet: At Sibos 2026, CLS Chief Risk Officer Deborah Hrvatin discusses the evolving risk landscape in the FX market, exploring how financial institutions can strengthen operational resilience while navigating geopolitical uncertainty, new technologies and market innovation.

title: Tesla ordered to pay $162,000 for Model X fire after failed ‘vandalism’ defense
snippet: Tesla told a Quebec court that car fires are “generally” caused by misuse or vandalism. The judge didn’t buy it, and Tesla Canada now has to cover the C$161,700 an insurer paid out for a Model X that burned in Montreal. An expert report traced the fire to an electrical failure in the dashboard of the 2020 Model X, which was still under Tesla’s warranty. Tesla offered no data to support its theory, and the court called it out for that. more…
